name: Dòng đèn vượt Thiên Lĩnh
scene: A long pilgrimage of immortal travelers crossing a steep mountain pass at blue twilight, PANORAMIC HIGH VIEW. Pack spirit deer, winter pines and a vast cloud sea. Smoky violet, deep blue, olive and lantern gold. Solidarity and endurance, no crowd packed in foreground, no giant moon.
